title: ALMA observations of AGN fuelling. The case of PKS B1718-649
question: Is cold molecular gas falling onto the SMBH of the young radio AGN PKS B1718-649, and does it fuel the radio source (e.g. via chaotic cold accretion)?

what.value: SINFONI H2 1-0 S(1) data, rotation curve model and H2 spectra

evidence.quote: In (cite: maccagni2016), we estimated a model of the rotation curve of the inner disk

what.value: HI spectra and expected accretion rate ~1e-2 Msun/yr

evidence.quote: the expected accretion rate is $\dot{M}\sim 10^{-2}$ ${\rm M}_\odot$ yr$^{-1}$(cite: maccagni2014)
we assume a CO-to-H$_{\,2}$ abundance ratio, $A_C= 1.6\times10^{-4}$ (cite: sofia2004)

recipe.method: CASA reduction scripts, then MIRIAD self-cal, continuum subtraction and cleaning; cube and continuum image

recipe.goal: Moment maps, flux and kinematics of CO emission
recipe.method: Total intensity and velocity maps, PV diagram along disk major axis; systemic velocity from mean of velocity range
Optical depth from line against 230 GHz continuum; LTE column density equation, partition function, CO/H2 ratio
assumptions: Tex ~16 K, LTE, homogeneous absorber, A_C=1.6e-4

recipe.method: L'CO from flux (Solomon & Vanden Bout formula), M_H2 = alpha_CO L'CO
Distance limit from co-spatial red-shifted H2 (75 pc) and infall velocity, with absorber mass range

evidence.quote: The mass of the circumnuclear disk ranges between $5.35\times10^7$ ${\rm M}_\odot$ and $3.08\times10^8$ ${\rm M}_\odot$.
the mass of the in-falling molecular gas ranges between $3\times10^2$ ${\rm M}_\odot$ and $5\times10^5$ ${\rm M}_\odot$.

not_stated_but_needed: Briggs robust values explored and the continuum-free channels for subtraction
MIRIAD self-calibration parameters and CASA version
Clean masks, thresholds and cell/image size
How moment maps and PV cuts were made (clipping)
Cosmology-based D_L value used and exact absorption spectrum extraction aperture
Inconsistencies: L'CO 7.4e7 vs 7.3e7, FWHM 57.4 vs 54, Delta v 365 vs 345 km/s
score_reason: Public ALMA data and simple analysis, but imaging parameters and some numbers are missing or inconsistent.
rediscovery_reason: Single project, simple numeric measurements (fluxes, masses, absorption line properties) are redoable, though imaging details are missing.
